assertions.name: amphicheirality_non_alt_block_invariant
assertions.source: Amphicheirality: non-alternating blocks have χ_λ(β*) = +χ_λ(β); only λ = (1^n) flips sign.

assertions.name: alt_block_chi_values_finite
assertions.unit: boolean (1 = both characters nonzero — corollary's sign-flip property is recorded as DIAGNOSTIC; see author queue for figure-eight specifics)
assertions.source: Diagnostic: for figure-eight 4_1, both χ_(1^n)(β) and χ_(1^n)(β*) compute to +1 because the 1-dim alt-character depends only on writhe (= 0 for 4_1). The corollary's claim 'amphicheirality ⇒ sign flip on (1^n)' needs a more careful statement or the 4_1 application paragraph needs revision.

assertions.name: h_real_at_q_0
assertions.source: h = χ_{(1^n)}(β)/χ_{(1^n)}(1) must be finite real.

assertions.name: a_eq_1_minus_h_sq_finite_at_q_0
assertions.source: Knot factor a = 1 − h² evaluated at q_0.

description: I1 probe for cor:knot-factor-amphicheiral.  Verifies the amphicheirality sign property of Hecke characters on the figure-eight braid (β = σ_1 σ_2⁻¹ σ_1 σ_2⁻¹ ∈ B_3, the canonical amphicheiral knot) and the resulting reduction of the knot factor to a = 1 − h² on the alternating block.  Uses the 1-dim Hecke characters for the symmetric (3) block (σ → q) and the alternating (1,1,1) block (σ → -q⁻¹).
